verdict.rationale: Crossmint is an API/SDK-first infrastructure platform for wallets and agentic payments; the evidence shows only REST APIs, docs ingestion for coding assistants (Cursor/Copilot) to speed developer integration, and agent-to-merchant checkout flows — none of which describe operating Crossmint itself via natural-language commands. There is no chat/NL interface, no conversational admin console, or NL-driven configuration surfaced anywhere in the pack.
